'''Jumara 20 (February 7)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - The remaining members of [[Toveine Gazal]]'s expedition on the [[Black Tower]] is captured. Toveine is bonded to [[Logain Ablar]].
*[[1000 NE]] - Logain prevents the other Aes Sedai from taking their revenge out on Toveine.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Rand al'Thor]] returns to [[Cairhien]] and is told of the Bargain made with the [[Atha'an Miere]]. Rand is then punished by the ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' for leaving them behind.
